test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the passage correctly:
(1) She put each stack into the washing machine, taking care not to overfill it.
(2) She then chose an appropriate cycle and initiated the washing process.
(3) Depending on the type of fabric, she poured a proper amount of detergent accordingly.
(4) She gathered the laundry from various areas of the house, sorting whites from colored garments.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph describes a step-by-step process of doing laundry, and the sentences need to be arranged in a logical sequence.
 
• **Sentence 4 is the first sentence** as it introduces the initial action of gathering and sorting the laundry:
 
 
• "She gathered the laundry from various areas of the house, sorting whites from colored garments."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1 follows** as it describes putting the sorted laundry into the washing machine:
 
 
• "She put each stack into the washing machine, taking care not to overfill it."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 comes next** as it describes adding detergent according to the type of fabric:
 
 
• "Depending on the type of fabric, she poured a proper amount of detergent accordingly."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 2 is the last sentence** as it describes the final step of choosing the cycle and starting the washing process:
 
 
• "She then chose an appropriate cycle and initiated the washing process."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **4 - 1 - 3 - 2**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"She gathered the laundry from various areas of the house, sorting whites from colored garments. She put each stack into the washing machine, taking care not to overfill it. Depending on the type of fabric, she poured a proper amount of detergent accordingly. She then chose an appropriate cycle and initiated the washing process."</div
